{{Quote|There's an ancient fortress orbiting the Imperial homeworld Dromund Kaas. It's hidden by a powerful cloaking device. The Emperor rules his people from this cloaked fortress. Not even the highest-ranking Sith can find him.|[[Satele Shan]]|<ref name="TOR:GbtF" />}}
The '''Emperor's Fortress''', also known as the '''Emperor's space station''', was an ancient [[Space station/Legends|space station]] built for the [[Tenebrae|Emperor]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A fusion of modern and ancient technology, the station served as both temple and fortress for the supreme ruler of the Empire. The station possessed a [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking]] [[Prototype cloaking device|device]] of [[Gree/Legends|Gree]] design, and the station's security grid and [[Power core/Legends|power core]] utilized technology built by the ancient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]].

==History==
{{Quote|Malgus was planning to use this station to eradicate the Republic. I had to stop him.|The [[Alliance Commander]]|<ref name="TOR:DHotF" />}}
During the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], an [[Unidentified Imperial scientist|Imperial scientist]] became the only non-[[Sith/Legends|Sith]] to ever board the station when he performed an overhaul of the security systems, and his shuttle ''[[Deference]]'' contained a complete set of schematics for the fortress.<ref name="TOR:SZS">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Sub-Zero Showdown|Hoth}}</ref> A [[Jedi strike team (capture of the Sith Emperor)|Jedi strike team]] under the command of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tol Braga]] [[Mission to the Emperor's Fortress|boarded]] the station in order to capture the Emperor, but were turned to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and made into his servants. The [[Hero of Tython]] later escaped several months later.<ref name="TOR:Descent" />,

After the supposed death of the Emperor, the rogue [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]] claimed the station as his own and took it to [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]. The space station was at the center of the final stage of the [[Battle of Ilum]].<ref name="TOR:IUS" /> Modifications by the [[Anomid/Legends|Anomid]] [[Schism Collective]] allowed the station to host an armada of [[Cloaking device/Legends|stealth]] [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]] and utilize [[flux cannon]]s. It engaged elements of both the Republic and Imperial fleets in battle. When confronted by the strike team sent to defeat him, Malgus triggered the space station's [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct mechanism]], and the station was destroyed shortly following his defeat.<ref name="TOR:TFE">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|The False Emperor}}</ref>
